verdict_reasoning: Meta is a dominant platform with an exceptional network effect and operating margins. However, it currently trades at a 20% premium to its historical P/E and has a low FCF yield due to massive infrastructure spending. It's a top-tier business, just not at a bargain price.
elevator_pitch: Meta owns the infrastructure of social connection. While it's spending billions to become an AI leader, its core ad business is a cash machine that practically printed $60B last year. It is a fantastic business at a slightly high price; wait for a dip to buy.
target_entry_note: A price below $580 (closer to 24x P/E) would offer a much better margin of safety.
